_comment: The Cast page. 'members' is one entry per role number from the director's Role IDs tab: 'student' is filled in once the cast list is final (or from the Cast tab in the Google Sheet, which only needs Role # and Student). 'name' is their main role, 'also' lists their ensemble tracks. Which scenes each role is in comes from data/scenes.json. 'characters' is the Meet the Characters list lower on the page.
heading: Cast
intro: Our cast of 35, the role each student plays, and every scene they are in. Scenes with songs link straight to the practice tracks: one with vocals to learn from, and one with just the accompaniment to sing along to.
Until the cast list is final, students are listed by role number.

characters.heading: Meet the characters
characters.intro: Who's who in the sea, the sky and Prince Eric's palace.

items.name: Ariel
items.description: The heroine of our story, a little mermaid who longs to be human. A strong singer and dynamic performer. Ariel has some beautiful solos but must be able to convey meaning through gesture once she loses her voice.

items.name: Prince Eric
items.description: The adventurous prince who captures Ariel's heart. A charming performer with a sensitive nature. Prince Eric has a few small solos, but strong acting matters most in this role.

items.name: Sebastian
items.description: The meticulous and anxious crab who tries to keep Ariel safe while getting to lead some of the most memorable songs in the show! Sebastian can be played by a boy or girl.

items.name: Flounder
items.description: Ariel's sincere and sensitive best friend, loyal to the end. This spunky fish has a show-stopping solo in "She's in Love." Flounder can be cast with a girl or a boy with an unchanged voice.

items.name: King Triton
items.description: Rules the sea and is a force to be reckoned with. This non-singer needs to command the stage as a strong leader but also show the tenderness of a parent. A mature performer who feels comfortable playing father to Ariel and the Mersisters.

items.name: Ursula
items.description: The manipulative sea witch who tries to overthrow King Triton. She is cunning and devious and will stop at nothing to get what she wants.

items.name: Scuttle
items.description: The know-it-all seagull who serves as Ariel's expert on humans. Funny and off-beat. Look for good comedic timing and a willingness to have fun with Scuttle's eccentricities.

items.name: The Mersisters
items.description: Aquata, Andrina, Arista, Atina, Adella and Allana are Ariel's siblings, full of personality and sass. Great roles for talented singers and dancers who can create six distinctive characters.

items.name: Flotsam & Jetsam
items.description: Ursula's slippery spies. These electric eels are sinister and sneaky, underhanded and devious while still being heard on stage. Flotsam and Jetsam can be played by boys or girls.

items.name: Grimsby
items.description: Prince Eric's prim and proper valet. Rigid in personality and constantly trying to guide Prince Eric towards the throne.

items.name: Chef Louis
items.description: The over-the-top head chef in the palace, always wild and frenetic. An excellent featured role for a comedic performer.

items.name: Carlotta
items.description: The headmistress in Prince Eric's palace and Ariel's greatest human ally. This non-singing role needs to be warm and maternal to make Ariel feel welcome.

items.name: The Pilot
items.description: The head sailor on Prince Eric's ship.

items.name: The Seahorse
items.description: The court herald for King Triton.

items.name: Tentacles
items.description: Extensions of Ursula, perhaps the poor unfortunate souls who are now trapped in her lair.

items.name: Gulls
items.description: Scuttle's flock of zany "back-up singers" who help explain human stuff to Ariel.

items.name: The Chefs
items.description: Chef Louis's assistants.

items.name: The Six Princesses
items.description: They try everything they can to win the heart of Prince Eric. The six Princesses can double as the six Mersisters.

items.name: The Sailors
items.description: The crew of Prince Eric's ship.

items.name: Sea Chorus
items.description: Creates each world within the show. The Sea Chorus can double as Merfolk, Sea Creatures and Lagoon Animals.

items.name: Merfolk
items.description: King Triton's Court. They can double as Sea Creatures.

items.name: Lagoon Animals
items.description: They try to convince Prince Eric to kiss Ariel. This ensemble can double as the Sea Creatures.
